name: Gust Johs Huhtala — wife Lisa Jöransdotter and son Jöran (b. 1820, Kauhava)
researcher_question: Did Gust Johs Huhtala of Kauhava, Vaasa have a son Jöran, born 3 February 1820 to a wife named Lisa Jöransdotter — or does that baptism belong to a different Huhtala household?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 10, hint-samples.csv row 356, flag adds_spouse, confidence 3). RESOLVED 2026-09-17: the hint is a false match. The Kauhava communion book (rippikirja) IAa:12, image group 100775028, folia 177 and 179, shows two different men named Gustaf Johansson at Huhtala farm N:o 40 — the tree person born 1794 with wife Caisa Johansdotter, and a second man born 1780 with wife Lisa Jöransdotter, whose son Jöran was born 3 February 1820. Encoded as an avoid finding plus a required negative conclusion. See README "Notes for reviewers".
